mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% indicates severe labor market distress, which typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) during the post-recession recovery phase indicates persistent supply-side weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy struggles to regain momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO declines in the post-recession phase, or the Rank IC is below 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates improving job market conditions, which typically leads to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate exceeding 2.5% signals potential monetary tightening, which increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals the market is pricing in the bottom of the housing cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy begins to recover.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST declines during a recession, or the Rank IC is below 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with unemployment rate above 9.5% signals a severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE > 9.5%, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression model.
